name: red-adjudication
description: One content-diff structural finding: is content really lost, or is the red a join/split artefact, a covered deviation or an intended transformation? Cascade shape: every noul is 'is this wrong', gate on the maximum (#126).

fields.finding: { kind, root, text: the diff line }
fields.source_slice: the source-side text around the finding
fields.build_slice: the build-side text around the finding
fields.deviations: the page's logged contentDeviations[] (kind + reason), possibly empty

dropped.instructions: Is text present in `source_slice` absent from `build_slice` — dropped, not merely moved or re-wrapped?

criteria.true: Words or a whole element from the source do not appear on the build side at all.
criteria.false: Every source word appears on the build side, possibly in a different element or order.

reworded.instructions: Has the build changed the wording of text that `source_slice` carries — different words, not just different splitting into elements?

reordered.instructions: Does `build_slice` present the same text as `source_slice` in a different reading order?

joined_or_split.instructions: Is the difference between `source_slice` and `build_slice` only that lines or elements were joined or split, with the same words in the same order?

criteria.true: Same words, same order; one side has them in more or fewer elements.
criteria.false: Words differ, are missing, or are in another order.

hidden.instructions: Does `finding` describe content that exists on the build side but is not visible to a reader (hidden, collapsed, moved off-page)?

covered_by_deviation.instructions: Does one of `deviations` explain and intend the difference `finding` reports?

criteria.true: A logged deviation names this element or kind of change with a reason.
criteria.false: No deviation mentions it, or the deviation is about something else.
